reasoning: The question asks if 95%+ of Nigerians will have bank accounts before 2025. The evidence shows: (1) Financial inclusion reached 74% in 2023 (EFInA survey), up from 56% in 2020. (2) The original 2024 target of 95% was not met; targets were revised to 2028. (3) One source claims 135 accounts per 100 people in 2025, but this counts multiple accounts per person, not unique account holders. (4) Global Findex 2025 data shows Nigeria saw 20+ percentage point increases recently, but from a lower base. (5) The CBN revised targets from 2024 to 2028, indicating the 2024 goal was missed. Since we're evaluating before 2025 (likely meaning by end of 2024), and the evidence shows 74% inclusion in 2023 with the 2024 target unmet, reaching 95% by 2025 is highly unlikely.
